title: Job: Man's Days Are Few

questions.question: Man who is born of a woman is what?
options: Few of days and full of trouble
questions.correctAnswer: Few of days and full of trouble
questions.explanation: Job 14:1 (ESV): "Man who is born of a woman is few of days and full of trouble."

questions.question: He comes out like a what and withers?
questions.explanation: Job 14:2 (ESV): "He comes out like a flower and withers..."

questions.question: There is hope for a what, if it be cut down?
questions.explanation: Job 14:7 (ESV): "For there is hope for a tree, if it be cut down, that it will sprout again..."

questions.question: If a man dies, shall he what?
questions.explanation: Job 14:14 (ESV): "If a man dies, shall he live again?"

questions.question: Waters wear away what?
questions.explanation: Job 14:19 (ESV): "The waters wear away the stones; the torrents wash away the soil of the earth..."

questions.question: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean?
questions.explanation: Job 14:4 (ESV): "Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? There is not one."

questions.question: Look away from him and leave him alone, that he may enjoy his day like a what?
questions.explanation: Job 14:6 (ESV): "that he may enjoy, like a hired hand, his day."

questions.question: Though its root grow old in the earth, yet at the scent of what it will bud?
questions.explanation: Job 14:9 (ESV): "yet at the scent of water it will bud and put out branches like a young plant."

questions.question: But a man dies and is laid low; man breathes his last, and where is he?
questions.explanation: Job 14:10 (ESV): "man breathes his last, and where is he?"

questions.question: Man lies down and does not rise until what?
questions.explanation: Job 14:12 (ESV): "till the heavens are no more he will not awake or be roused out of his sleep."

questions.question: Oh that you would hide me in what?
questions.explanation: Job 14:13 (ESV): "Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would conceal me until your wrath be past..."

questions.question: You would call, and I would what?
questions.explanation: Job 14:15 (ESV): "You would call, and I would answer you; you would long for the work of your hands."

questions.question: My transgression would be sealed up in a what?
questions.explanation: Job 14:17 (ESV): "my transgression would be sealed up in a bag, and you would cover over my iniquity."

questions.question: So you destroy the hope of whom?
questions.explanation: Job 14:19 (ESV): "...so you destroy the hope of man."

questions.question: His sons come to honor, and he does what?
questions.explanation: Job 14:21 (ESV): "His sons come to honor, and he does not know it; they are brought low, and he perceives it not."

key_verse_text: If a man dies, shall he live again? All the days of my service I would wait, till my renewal should come.
